- Around line 637-638: Update the change-detection logic using existingById so
identical node text and hash still trigger handling when source_event_id or
project differs. Refresh the stored embedding’s ownership and project metadata
without regenerating its vector when only those binding fields change.
- Around line 584-585: Update the event-replacement flow around
derivedGraphNodeOps and upsertEvent to track which derived events and embeddings
are owned by the replaced event, then remove owned rows that are no longer
produced by the replacement. Handle empty text and changed chunk or sentence
IDs, without relying on event TTL for cleanup.
- Line 383: Update validateEvent to reject graph.node events whose text is not a
string during batch preflight, before any event is persisted or admitted.
Preserve valid string text and the existing handling of other event types.
